In June 2024, an article titled "Democratising Forecasting" was published in tORMS Today by INFORMS. The article highlights the significance of making forecasting tools and knowledge accessible to a broader audience, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).

Read the full article [here](https://pubsonline.informs.org/do/10.1287/orms.2024.02.01/full/)
